nodes.completed_tasks: ["Dump ALL etcd key-value pairs with values (not just keys). Use etcdctl_get with --prefix to read every key's value. Scan output for flag{{...}} pattern and Kubernetes secrets containing sensitive data.", "Use k8s_etcd_keys to extract Kubernetes secrets directly from etcd. This tool is purpose-built for Kubernetes secret extraction from the etcd key-value store, reading /registry/secrets/* paths and decoding base64 values automatically.", "Try etcd v3 API via curl (gRPC-gateway) to range-query all keys. POST to /v3/kv/range with base64-encoded empty key and range_end=0x00 (null byte = '\\0') to scan entire keyspace. Insecure TLS to bypass self-signed cert.", "Based on key enumeration from task-1, attempt to read Kubernetes secrets from the default namespace. Try /registry/secrets/default/flag, /registry/secrets/kube-system/flag, and any other secret paths discovered.", "Attempt to read a flag directly from etcd at root-level path /flag or /flag.txt (common CTF patterns). Also try /flags, /ctf/flag, and any flag-like paths discovered in task-1 enumeration.", "Enumerate ALL keys in etcd via unauthenticated access with TLS verification bypassed. Use etcdctl_get with --prefix --keys-only to discover the key namespace structure, looking for flag-related keys and Kubernetes secrets paths."]
